conclusions: MemoryUtil.CheckAndDisableAutoGcOnMatchStart has a call at0x15A0C20 to COW.GcUtil.DisableAutoGc, followed by memory baseline read at0x15A0C44. It is conditional and has not been observed active on the user phone.
COW.GcUtil.Collect at0x646568C uses the original game manual-GC reason path and restores disabled/manual policy through EnableGcImpl after its temporary collection-enable branch.
Pressure handler calls only original COW.GcUtil.Collect(ManualGCReason.MemoryUtilCollect), keeps all shared GC state untouched and samples memory every2seconds. It does not unload game resources.

policy.limitation: Full collection may cause a visible frame hitch; a true retained reference leak or native allocation/crash is not cured by collection.
